ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows part of the Miller-Urey experimental apparatus. On the left, H2O Vapor (water vapor) enters. In the middle it is labeled Primitive Earth Gases, and the listed gases include H2O Vapor, NH3, CH4, H2, and CO; above there is an Electrical Source (power source/electric spark) as the energy source; on the right it is labeled that water vapor is cyclically discharged with the airflow. Then reason: The question asks why molecules such as cysteine and methionine could not be detected, and what type of compounds was not included in the experiment. Cysteine and methionine are both sulfur-containing amino acids and require a source of sulfur element to form. The reactants listed in the figure only provide sources of elements such as C, H, O, and N and electric spark energy, and do not provide a source of S (sulfur). Therefore these sulfur-containing amino acids could not form or be detected, and what was not included in the experiment was sulfur-containing compounds.
